Microclimate facts
Sepis the city's warmest month — a 70°F normal high, against 67°F in July. Summer arrives in the fall.
12°Fbetween the warmest and coolest neighborhoods on a typical summer afternoon: Aquatic Park / Ft. Mason and Merced Heights.
928 ftMount Davidson, the top of the ridge (Twin Peaks 922, Sutro 909) that splits the city into a fog side and a sun side.
52–56°Fthe ocean off Ocean Beach in August. Wind pulls cold water up from below — that cold water is what makes the fog.
106°Fthe hottest day on record downtown, Sep 1, 2017 — in September, naturally.
2.5×what an SFH costs in Zone A against Zone D this year: $4.20M vs $1.70M median.
$156/sflower price per square foot, on average, for each extra hour of daily summer fog — 1,656 house sales this year.
800–1,500 ftthe usual top of the fog deck. Above it, the peaks sit in sunshine looking down on a white sea.

Sales: SFAR MLS closed sales, Jan 1 – Sep 30, 2026, each counted by the fog zone at the property — not a valuation of any property. Weather and climate figures are approximations.
